types.explanation: The DAAP request URI /server-info is the operation/type code for the server-info request. DAAP uses HTTP GET, and this URI uniquely selects the server information operation.
The request URI /content-codes uniquely selects the DAAP content-codes operation, which returns the list of content codes and their types.
The request URI /login uniquely identifies the DAAP login operation, which begins a session.
The request URI /logout uniquely identifies the DAAP logout operation, which ends a session.
The request URI /update uniquely identifies the DAAP update operation, which returns the current library/playlist revision number.

This URI pattern identifies the DAAP database-items request. [num] is a numeric database ID path parameter and does not change the message type; the path pattern selects the operation to list all items in a database.
This URI pattern identifies the DAAP database-containers request. [num] is a numeric database ID path parameter; the path pattern selects the operation to list all playlists/containers in a database.

This URI pattern identifies the DAAP database-container-items request. The two [num] placeholders are numeric database and container/playlist ID path parameters; the path pattern selects the operation to list items in a specific playlist.
The request URI /resolve uniquely identifies the DAAP resolve operation, used for resolving/playing a playlist or item.
